pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal geometries with high-contrast sharp edges on the neck, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented, and irregularly shaped dark regions on the lower flank; patch area is inversely proportional to density toward the posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways with predominantly trivalent junction nodes; corridor width is wider on the cervical region and narrows as it descends the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the neck mane; profile becomes smoother and less distinct at the shoulder transition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single, prominent vertical linear indentation with associated shadow-depth is visible on the central lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: An avian symbiont (oxpecker) is visible perched on the dorsal ridge at the cervico-thoracic junction.
